name: Forte AUD
oneLiner: AUDF is Forte Tech Solutions' centralized Australian dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 with AUD reserves and cash-equivalent assets held separately.
collateral: Australian dollar reserves and cash-equivalent reserve assets held separately from Forte's operational funds
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for AUD through Forte Tech Solutions for eligible account holders to approved bank accounts, with monthly independent reserve audits and daily reserve monitoring

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: AUDF resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

mintAuthority.summary: AUDF exposes role-gated issuer minting. Ethereum source shows mint functions require MINT_ROLE; current Ethereum role logs resolve one 2/5 Safe as default admin and MINT_ROLE holder, plus one additional MINT_ROLE holder.

controls.label: AUDF default admin / MINT_ROLE Safe
controls.evidence: Ethereum role reconstruction found this Safe holding DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINT_ROLE. Safe Transaction Service identified it as a 2/5 Safe with no enabled modules and zero guard.

controls.label: AUDF additional MINT_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: Ethereum role reconstruction found this address holding MINT_ROLE. Sourcify source shows mint(address,uint256) and mint(uint256) require MINT_ROLE, but this holder's custody model was not identified.

review.evidence: Sourcify source identifies AUDF mint functions gated by MINT_ROLE; Ethereum role reconstruction identifies the current default admin and MINT_ROLE holders for the AUDF token.
unresolvedQuestions: Reconstruct Polygon, Avalanche, and Base role holders before treating AUDF as fully reviewed across all deployments.
Identify the non-Safe MINT_ROLE holder and the ProxyAdmin owner/custody setup.
Decide whether burn, pause, and blacklist roles should be separately represented outside mint authority.
